name: Farlight
description: A sunlike star holding the far halo's edge with two quiet rocky worlds. Its light is the last familiar thing outbound ships see. The farlight stations keep that light honest.

stars.name: Farlight Steady
stars.description: A calm yellow dwarf with output steady enough for outbound calibration. Its spectrum is the farewell standard. Ships log it as the last friendly light.

planets.name: Outbound
planets.description: A basalt rock hosting the last fuel depot before the intergalactic dark. Tanks the size of towns gleam on the night side. Every crew tops up here and signs the wall.

planets.name: Farella
planets.description: A thin-aired world of high cold deserts under a pale sun. Refugee charters prize its obscurity above all else. Its sunsets fade through colors with no names.
